objective.claim: develop a separately attributable multi-asset automated trend system that beats exact V8

long_history.title: A Century of Evidence on Trend-Following Investing

independent_research_basis.transfer_limit: published multi-asset trend evidence motivates only the broad direct-market mechanism; it does not validate these H4 windows, FPMarkets CFDs, 100 USD capacity, swap/spread model, exits, risk or V8 gates

isolation.existing_runtime_cache_use: one-time copy of non-price account/server session support from a stopped project-local non-Master Lab Portable is allowed; no existing runtime price/history cache may be copied or read for prices, and no other runtime may be executed by this family

excluded_inputs: Family 001 through Family 008 features, models, predictions, states, decisions, trades and outcomes
V1-V8 signals, opportunity timestamps, component labels, state and economics
Optimization candidate signals, states, ledgers and outcomes
material_distinctions: direct positions in seven currency and equity-index markets rather than a single target or external-to-target transfer
multi-week trend persistence and asymmetric tail capture rather than intraday direction classification or fixed barrier prediction
portfolio-level simultaneous-entry priority and aggregate open-risk ownership rather than isolated event sizing
two predeclared medium/slow channel realizations with no learned label, outcome-selected threshold or V8 state
closed_neighborhoods_excluded: QQQ/TQQQ close pressure and its continuation/reversal/rank/coherence/exit rescues
AUDCHF pulse and adjacent FX-to-index transfer rescues
two-index residual baskets and adjacent hedge/z/window rescues
target-only H1/H4/M15/M1 model or threshold rescues

selection_only_availability.source: stopped non-Master original-broker selected-symbol metadata; account-specific basename omitted

fresh_development_acquisition.price_basis: broker-native MT5 Bid OHLC; row spread times point reconstructs Ask
fresh_development_acquisition.acquisition_path: fresh copy_rates_range through the family-owned dedicated Portable only after this declaration reaches origin/main
fresh_development_acquisition.atomicity: commit no final family source unless all seven H4 files and specifications complete and pass integrity
fresh_development_acquisition.platform_bootstrap_cache_boundary: build 6140 may transiently populate currently selected default-symbol history while establishing the session without a rates API call; purge all such files before acquisition, persist only raw timestamps inside the declared development request, purge every transient 2026 HCC after the stopped acquisition, and never let the adapter read runtime history cache

source_inputs.locked_2026: not requested, acquired or opened until one unchanged complete development passer exists

raw_time_semantics.source_encoding: connected-broker server wall-clock encoded as Unix-like epoch seconds, not semantic UTC
raw_time_semantics.normalization: render the raw integer as timezone-naive wall-clock, attach Europe/Helsinki with IANA rules, then convert to true UTC before period and event ordering
raw_time_semantics.bar_cadence: use the next chronologically observed same-symbol H4 bar; do not fill weekends, holidays, session gaps or missing bars

bar_state.decision_bar: one completed same-symbol H4 bar t
bar_state.entry_bar: the next chronologically observed same-symbol H4 bar t+1
bar_state.channel_inputs: only H4 bars completed before decision bar t; decision bar is excluded from its breakout channel
bar_state.atr_inputs: twenty completed true ranges ending with decision bar t; every true range uses the prior observed same-symbol close
bar_state.true_range: maximum of high-low, absolute high-prior-close and absolute low-prior-close
bar_state.missing_history: no decision until the variant channel, exit channel and ATR histories are all complete
bar_state.portfolio_active_date: a true-UTC date containing at least one fully formed next-bar decision opportunity in the seven-symbol universe; zero-signal active dates remain in turnover denominator

candidate_bundle.long_entry_signal: decision-bar Bid close strictly above the maximum Bid high of the prior entry-channel bars
candidate_bundle.short_entry_signal: decision-bar Bid close strictly below the minimum Bid low of the prior entry-channel bars
candidate_bundle.existing_position: ignore new entry signals for that symbol until its lifecycle closes; no reversal-in-place
candidate_bundle.entry: direction-specific market entry at the next observed same-symbol H4 open
candidate_bundle.normalized_breakout_excess: for long, decision close minus prior channel high; for short, prior channel low minus decision close; divide by frozen ATR20
candidate_bundle.same_timestamp_entry_priority: larger normalized breakout excess first, then frozen symbol order

lifecycle.hard_stop: fixed at entry execution price plus or minus one risk distance; it never widens or trails
lifecycle.long_stop: entry Ask minus risk distance, evaluated on Bid low
lifecycle.short_stop: entry Bid plus risk distance, evaluated on Ask high
lifecycle.same_bar_entry_and_stop: entry occurs at bar open and adverse hard stop wins before any close-based rule
lifecycle.long_channel_exit_condition: at a completed held H4 close, Bid close is strictly below the minimum Bid low of the immediately prior exit-channel bars, excluding that just-completed bar
lifecycle.short_channel_exit_condition: at a completed held H4 close, Bid close is strictly above the maximum Bid high of the immediately prior exit-channel bars, excluding that just-completed bar
lifecycle.channel_exit_execution: schedule direction-specific market exit at the next observed same-symbol H4 open; a scheduled open exit occurs before any action inside that bar
lifecycle.maximum_hold_exit: after hard-stop evaluation, close direction-specifically at the close of the 480th held H4 bar
exit_priority: previously scheduled channel exit at current bar open
new opposite-channel condition scheduled for next bar open

position_and_portfolio_risk.risk_per_lot: risk distance divided by trade tick size times trade_tick_value_loss
position_and_portfolio_risk.volume_rounding: floor target-risk lots to the symbol volume step and volume maximum; use the minimum lot only when its planned stop loss is at most six percent of current actual balance
position_and_portfolio_risk.aggregate_reservation: sum each open lifecycle's original planned stop loss plus sequentially accepted same-timestamp entries; block a new entry when the sum exceeds eighteen percent of the post-open-exit actual balance snapshot
position_and_portfolio_risk.passive_cap_breach_after_balance_change: does not force liquidation but blocks new entries until capacity returns
position_and_portfolio_risk.same_timestamp_sequence: execute all scheduled open exits, snapshot balance and existing reservations, rank all eligible entries, reserve sequentially, then evaluate intrabar stops and closes
position_and_portfolio_risk.insolvency_or_nonfinite_balance: block later entries without rewriting completed lifecycles

quote_cost_and_swap.Ask: Bid plus row spread times symbol point
quote_cost_and_swap.money_conversion: price distance divided by tick size times direction-appropriate trade_tick_value_profit or trade_tick_value_loss times volume
quote_cost_and_swap.actual_spread: one direction-specific observed spread through Bid/Ask execution
quote_cost_and_swap.extra_stress: subtract that lifecycle's observed direction-specific spread burden once more
quote_cost_and_swap.swap_source: the freshly acquired pinned symbol specification
quote_cost_and_swap.swap_application: for every crossed broker-server rollover date while a lifecycle is open, apply the frozen long/short swap rate and swap_rollover3days multiplier using the documented MT5 swap mode

supported_swap_modes.POINTS: swap rate times point divided by tick size times tick value times volume and rollover multiplier
supported_swap_modes.CURRENCY_DEPOSIT: swap rate in USD times volume and rollover multiplier
supported_swap_modes.INTEREST_CURRENT: signed annual swap percent divided by 100, times contract size, rollover reference price and volume, divided by 360 and multiplied by rollover multiplier
supported_swap_modes.INTEREST_OPEN: signed annual swap percent divided by 100, times contract size, entry price and volume, divided by 360 and multiplied by rollover multiplier

quote_cost_and_swap.swap_rate_sign: apply the broker specification's signed long or short rate without absolute-value conversion; negative rates debit and positive rates credit
quote_cost_and_swap.unsupported_or_nonconvertible_swap_mode: preoutcome source/engineering correction required; no economic process may start

dimensions: raw breakout-direction close return, MFE and MAE at 1, 3, 6 and 12 completed H4 bars
medium versus slow signal overlap, unique opportunities, admission and normalized realized R
2024 versus 2025, symbol, currency versus equity-index and long versus short stability
observed spread, doubled-spread stress and swap burden relative to gross movement
minimum-lot, aggregate-risk, already-open and capital-depletion blocks
hard-stop, opposite-channel and maximum-hold exit attribution and truncation
improvement_potential_audit.broad_headroom_definition: cost-surviving directionally consistent raw trend or exit benefit in both development years, both asset classes, both directions and at least four individual symbols rather than one horizon, symbol, direction or tail
improvement_potential_audit.decision_rule: do not close merely because the first or either horizon fails; complete both and this audit, then close only when no broad causal improvement headroom remains
improvement_potential_audit.audit_authority_limit: the audit cannot execute or authorize a new channel, ATR, stop, exit, maximum hold, symbol subset, priority, risk or sizing rule; a genuinely new path requires whole-map recompare and a separately named durable declaration

python_adapter_owns: fresh seven-symbol H4 and specification integrity
Europe/Helsinki server-wall-clock normalization and causal H4 ordering
Donchian channels, ATR20, breakout direction and normalized excess
portfolio open-state mirror, simultaneous priority, initial-stop reservations and decision sequence/freshness
ea_must_own: adapter schema, variant, sequence and freshness validation
all seven symbol contract, tick, lot, swap and market-state validation
balance-based volume, minimum-lot and aggregate risk caps
hard stop, scheduled channel exit, maximum-hold close and bounded swap/execution evidence

development_gates.selection: highest stressed net among complete passers, then lower drawdown, then higher minimum yearly stressed net, then frozen variant order

native_escalation.condition: exactly one unchanged variant is selected from complete development passers and then passes locked and whole proxy gates
required_architecture: family-owned Python adapter and byte-pinned seven-symbol decision tape
native_escalation.tester_model: FPMarkets Every tick based on real ticks with 100% real ticks for every exercised symbol

ordered_stages: declaration before dedicated runtime, H4/specification acquisition, channels, ATR, implementation or economics
fresh development-only seven-symbol H4 acquisition and complete specifications
complete adapter implementation and abort-before-write outcome-free source, channel-capacity, turnover-capacity and minimum-lot precheck
freeze exact implementation before any lifecycle or economic path
one complete 2024-2025 two-horizon development bundle plus mandatory improvement-potential audit
locked 2026 acquisition and confirmation for at most one unchanged selected complete passer
self-contained Python adapter plus EA compile and one native candidate path only for a complete whole-proxy survivor

stop_rules.one_variant_failure: continue the already frozen sibling horizon and improvement-potential audit; do not close from the first economic view
stop_rules.no_development_passer_and_no_broad_headr: close before locked 2026, EA and MT5 after both variants and the audit complete
stop_rules.no_development_passer_but_broad_headroom: record one bounded successor seed only; do not execute it inside V1, and recompare the whole map before any separately named declaration
stop_rules.confirmation_or_whole_proxy_failure: close before EA and MT5 after recording the same audit dimensions
stop_rules.environment_source_or_engineering_fault: correct and rerun without economic verdict or arbitrary retry cap
stop_rules.success: record verified native V8 Challenge victory; Live still requires a separate user-authorized engineering and handoff decision
